coordinate_frame.origin_definition: official GIS polygon largest-ring centroid from existing Purdue official footprint reference; use master placement marker at this XY
coordinate_frame.transform: X=(longitude + 86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(latitude - 40.4274)*111040; local XY subtract centroid

footprint_validation.transform_method: ArcGIS EPSG:3857 source was requested as EPSG:4326 GeoJSON; vertices were transformed to the project's local approximate east/north metric frame, then the ring centroid was recalculated by shoelace formula. The independently calculated centroid matches the saved campus reference center exactly.

interior_interpretation: Schematic only. The architect photo supports a double-height public lobby, reception counter, dark display wall, partial mezzanine/guardrail, lounge seating, low tables and planting. No complete, georegistered building plan was found; furniture, atrium extent, orientation, partition locations and individual room layouts are not surveyed.
uncertainty: The official GIS FID 946 confirms the building identity and plan polygon but is not a certified survey; its 12-point ring cannot verify the wall line, openings, dimensions or entrance offset.
The five-story count is verified; individual floor-to-floor heights, roof elevation and monument height remain photo-scaled estimates.
The West/Foundry frontage and portal direction are inferred from official address, source photos and Google Maps context; the precise door bay and freestanding sign offset are estimated.
The flat roof and parapet are photo-supported, while exact roof equipment type and locations remain illustrative.
The interior is a source-guided lobby vignette; it is not a reconstructed floor plan because no full plan could be registered to the GIS shell.

validation.fresh_open_check: Separate Blender 5.2.3 process opened the exact saved asset, verified FID 946 and stable local-coordinate export collection/origin, material texture wiring and absence of external image dependencies, checked the punched facade/window separation, and rerendered the scene.
validation.note: AABB check tests sign/canopy separation only, not all-scene collision geometry. Source photographs were used for reference and are not linked or embedded as textures.
